format.noise: noise(): uniform, used by the original kit; gnoise(): gaussian, used by the Ring Escape sounds. The Ring Escape bank is exported last so the older files keep their exact noise.

master.limit: None (default: tanh only) or a fraction of the post-tanh peak; 0.46 in Sword Roulette and Ring Escape (look-ahead 6 ms, release 80 ms)

parts.drums: kick 1+3, snare 2+4, hats 8ths, crash every 4 bars

music.fanfare: C5-E5-G5-C6 square arpeggio + C major triangle chord + crash + kick
music.slowmo: music ducked to 0.65 of a 500 Hz low-pass copy; cut 0.06 s at the final blow

mountain_king.piece: Grieg, In the Hall of the Mountain King (1875, public domain), own arrangement
mountain_king.notes: (MIDI note, eighths) list MOUNTAIN_KING = A A B A A B; staccato: 62 % of an eighth, 80 % of longer notes
mountain_king.lead: saw_pluck (saw + square, low-pass 900 + 2600*bright Hz) vol 0.17, pan -0.15; stage 2: 0.2 plus an octave-up double at 0.07, pan 0.25
mountain_king.drums: stage 1: kick 0.386 on beats 1+3, clap 0.22 on 2+4, hats 0.101 on 8ths (open on every 4th); stage 2: kick on every beat x1.19, hats x1.33
mountain_king.fills: on each long (4-eighth) note: 4 claps on 16ths in its second half (gain 0.07 rising by 0.04) + sweep_up 250->900 Hz at 0.035

music.fanfare_brass: B4-D#5-F#5-B5 saw-pluck arpeggio 75 ms apart with octave-up dings, then a B-major brass chord (B3 D#4 F#4 B4 D#5) for 1.8 s + bass B2 + kick, 2.2 s

sfx.whoosh: sword flies to the chosen ball
sfx.pop: small sword pops on / UI pop
sfx.clash_big: a clash involving the BIG sword
sfx.riser: slow-mo build-up (set length to the slow-mo): noise band [0.7f, 1.4f] climbing 250->3500 Hz in 24 log steps, 6 ms crossfades, envelope (t/dur)^2.2, x RISER_LEVEL 3.31
sfx.clack: marble hits marble: partials f and 1.47f (default f 3650 Hz) + noise tick, 60 ms
sfx.shatter: glass ring breaks: bright noise burst, 26 random pings 2.5-7.5 kHz in 0.28 s, low thump, 0.55 s (seed per ring)
sfx.sweep_up: tonal power-up glide 300->1400 Hz with 2nd harmonic (speed-up cue, fills)
sfx.clap: hand clap: 900-3800 Hz band noise, three bursts 11 ms apart
sfx.brass_stab: B-minor brass stab (B2 F#3 B3 D4), 1.1 s: the last ring becomes active
sfx.fanfare_brass: B-major brass fanfare: Ring Escape win

slowmo_sfx: events inside slow motion are played slower/lower: factor 1/max(rate, 0.45), capped at 1.9

ring_escape_mix.per_event: shatter 0.42 + rising B-minor pentatonic ding chime per broken ring; metal 1700 Hz on gap-edge hits, 1250 Hz on the last ring; clack on marble collisions; tick on wall bounces (1500 + 90*ring Hz)
ring_escape_mix.k_gains: K_* factors RMS-match each kit sound to the level the Ring Escape mix was balanced with
